ITAZip Support

ITAZip is an archive utility for macOS 13 or later. It supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs. The app is free, with no in-app purchases or account requirement. Publisher: HYUNSUNG LEE.

Open and extract an archive

Open an archive in ITAZip, then choose an extraction destination. ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, and other supported formats can be opened. Select individual entries when you only need part of an archive. A password-protected archive requires the correct password. Support cannot recover an unknown password for you.

For a multipart archive, keep all parts in the same folder and open the first part. Missing parts, incomplete downloads, or damaged archives can cause extraction to fail. Keep the original archive until you have checked the extracted files.

Open from Finder

In Finder, select an archive and choose Open With, then ITAZip. To use ITAZip for that file type, open Get Info, select ITAZip under Open with, and choose Change All. File associations apply separately to each archive type. Settings in ITAZip also provide Finder integration options.

If a file or destination is unavailable, select it again through the macOS file picker. This renews the app's permission to access it. Make sure that cloud files are downloaded and that the destination has enough free space.

Create archives and manage passwords

Choose files or folders and a supported output format to create an archive. ZIP and 7Z are useful options for sharing. Format support differs between creating and extracting archives. RAR extraction does not mean RAR creation is available.

Save a password in the password manager only if you want it stored in your Mac Keychain. You can remove saved entries there. Keep a separate copy of important passwords. Neither the publisher nor support receives your saved passwords.

Report a problem

Email the public contact. Include your macOS version, Mac model, ITAZip version and build, archive format, error message, and steps to reproduce the problem. Describe what you expected and what happened. Use a small example that contains no private information if a sample is needed. Do not send passwords or confidential archives.

For TestFlight builds, you can also send feedback through TestFlight. Reply times are not guaranteed. Feature availability can differ between app versions.
